QLS System Algorithm — Natural Intelligence Loop</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8087-85c7-dd29082e5937" class="">Global definition: any intelligent system executes four core operations:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80fc-b2e7-e4f319fdd0d1" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Discrimination</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8091-b18f-c47624b1ec39" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Separate signal from noise.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b5-81aa-d8c229aa1fa8" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Maintain identity boundary: what belongs, 
what does not.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b5-a292-d56be217d591" class="numbered-list" start="2"><li><strong>Compression</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-801e-9e21-d716f48986b3" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Retain only information needed for function.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8026-9d11-c7b0e73d3002" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Reduce complexity while preserving essential structure.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80cf-b586-d715375a1b43" class="numbered-list" start="3"><li><strong>Prediction</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8054-b5b3-e391ccd69422" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Use current structure to forecast near-future states.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-808d-acdb-c27428d02794" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Test integrity against likely future conditions.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b0-bd18-fac5a84f76d5" class="numbered-list" start="4"><li><strong>Correction</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-806f-81a2-d27b998720c9" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Use feedback to repair deviation before collapse.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80f4-83e9-c64dc126a65f" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Update structure without losing identity.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80c8-9185-ec972d1311ed" class="">Algorithmic loop:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul i
d="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8048-84d9-cac7957d16dc" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><strong>Loop:</strong><br/>Discriminate → Compress → Predict → Correct → repeat</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8086-83d2-ee4ad355a109" class="">This holds for:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b2-848b-c5d1d9f55cb9" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">nervous systems</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80fd-92ef-c4d123c6cda1" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">scientific method</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-801b-b6d6-ef411955198f" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">good governance</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b9-b55c-e988efc3a8a9" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">robust AI architectures</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8015-acbf-f35a728ca836"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80ee-9268-d17776aecf86" class="">B2. 
Logic Measurement Algorithm</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80da-97c2-ce81bd75401f" class="">Objective: measure logical strength L of a system S.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-803e-bd47-c89e4095cacc" class="">Steps:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8013-9fae-fb0f9db77f7f" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Map system structure.</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-809a-8e21-cbbfc3bb91b4" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Identify essential components and relationships.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-801f-bf0d-ecb261996d62" class="numbered-list" start="2"><li><strong>Measure Integrity (I):</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8087-a4c3-fddd24d4b43d" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Count and classify internal contradictions.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80bf-87a6-e35e874d4b6c" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Evaluate alignment between stated rules and actual behaviour.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b3-a03f-f71e63ef1e38" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Lower contradiction = higher I.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8081-bce7-dee378c34a34" class="numbered-list" start="3"><li><strong>Measure Stability (S):</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8064-aa4e-d3e7c67eeca7" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Observe performance under variation, stress, scale, 
and time.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80ca-83da-cce8789838ca" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Measure rate of drift and capacity for self-correction.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b0-827f-ecf0be98284f" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Lower drift, faster correction = higher S.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80c2-aecc-fee985db2819" class="numbered-list" start="4"><li><strong>Compute L:</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8017-a172-c0bc5f2480a8" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">L = f(I, S), conceptually L ≈ I × S.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-801a-8c84-c182c0b5c834" class="numbered-list" start="5"><li><strong>Diagnose weak dimension:</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8088-a0c1-cfbf11861b04" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">If I strong, S weak → improve feedback and adaptation.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80a6-b5ac-f498a4cbb8e6" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">If S strong, I weak → resolve contradictions and structural gaps.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-806d-b09d-ce3dd0d426ed" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">If both weak → halt expansion, 
rebuild foundation.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b1-8a72-d26cb1a113a9" class="numbered-list" start="6"><li><strong>Re-test periodically</strong> to track improvement or decay.</li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8014-bdd4-e0c5e33aa0fa"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-802a-b388-d24535d352f0" class="">B3. 
Logic Failure Detection Algorithm</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80c6-91e1-f5b22331e0ef" class="">To detect early failure in any system:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8029-af62-e1083500d95d" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li>Scan for <strong>Contradiction</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8036-8270-e8040a8ac025" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Internal rules vs observed behaviour.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8047-90a0-fba0ac48fef9" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Policy vs practice.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8074-bca6-dea24cc3e4c0" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Theory vs data.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-807f-a147-dd60dbd22648" class="numbered-list" start="2"><li>Detect <strong>Distortion</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80c4-9466-fea8342aa4bf" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Justifications that defend contradiction without resolving it.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8031-bb21-c9047d657b0b" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Selective data, rationalisation, denial, 
narrative cover.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80e4-a9db-f2d509e73119" class="numbered-list" start="3"><li>Track <strong>Drift</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80ed-aa6a-c774fc6fbed1" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Increasing gap between intention and outcome.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80ac-949d-e59615068e74" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Rising error rates, instability, loss of predictability.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80e2-b3e9-d72d9ef03d90" class="numbered-list" start="4"><li>Predict <strong>Collapse</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80d7-878b-c0a40de0e4da" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Extrapolate drift beyond repair capacity.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8091-b5cd-ed1d46b39cb6" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Identify thresholds where the system can no longer self-correct.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80d3-90f9-d099dfeaa628" class="">Action: intervene before or at Distortion/early Drift, not at Collapse.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80ed-96ef-f23e592db913"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8013-92a1-f516c241746d" class="">B4. 
Logic Recovery Algorithm</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8093-8e4d-f58edb4fa016" class="">To restore a failing system:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80e8-b8c5-f8aeaf1f4312" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Stop expansion.</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8098-9902-de961f76b156" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Freeze scope creep and new dependencies.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-808f-a184-c1330fa94653" class="numbered-list" start="2"><li><strong>Restore Integrity:</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b8-bf00-f5480ba1eafe" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Identify contradictions.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80cd-b110-dfb835f1fce1" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Remove or reconcile them.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8068-a803-e82517d94288" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Realign inner rules with actual behaviour.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-802f-a0ee-fdfd37fce3b1" class="numbered-list" start="3"><li><strong>Rebuild Stability:</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80c4-94b7-d5e6c7d77482" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Shorten feedback loops.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8003-a657-c7bcb266aa4b" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Increase transparency.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8055-9fe1-f6e358df52c5" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Add monitoring points at critical i
nterfaces.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b2-8124-e6970cb5b6a0" class="numbered-list" start="4"><li><strong>Reconnect Feedback:</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8073-bf73-f2816b5d95f9" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Reopen blocked information flows.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-805e-bf27-d47cbac14947" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Ensure error signals reach decision points.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8055-879b-c93d3f327468" class="numbered-list" start="5"><li><strong>Re-test L periodically</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8021-9fe7-c00ef0b6ff76" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">reassess I, S and adjust as needed.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8082-9a89-f5d2c7ceec3c"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80ec-8cac-c954a2f3b3d2" class="">B5. 
Identity Formation Algorithm (Individual)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-808e-9a4e-e1eaaf889ef8" class="">Stepwise mapping of the causal chain you defined:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80d0-a25e-f8f73958b2d6" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Quantum Input Layer (L₁):</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8011-ae30-f10b394d3676" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Baseline sensitivity to environment, fields, prenatal conditions.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-806a-a1d4-eee7c11f5360" class="numbered-list" start="2"><li><strong>Chemical Layer (L₂):</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80ac-a82d-f98ee69e6c2a" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Neurotransmitter and hormonal ratios establish emotional tone.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8096-a57e-f313189d3f1e" class="numbered-list" start="3"><li><strong>Biological Activation Layer (L₃):</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8027-aa8b-d6d224061201" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Nervous system patterns, trauma load, 
somatic responses solidify.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80cf-bff7-d3c95b506f8e" class="numbered-list" start="4"><li><strong>Cognitive Layer (L₄):</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8081-bfe5-e7089cb4ae93" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Language and narrative form around biological experience.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-802e-ba3f-d8095a9f9d3e" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Person “explains” what the earlier layers are doing.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-801a-8243-d03a62fbbf9d" class="numbered-list" start="5"><li><strong>Behavioural Layer (L₅):</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8072-bfe7-e8e2bb2b74d0" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Repeated actions based on L₁–L₄ under real-world conditions.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-801a-a7a0-e0ba318d4b40" class="numbered-list" start="6"><li><strong>Consolidated Identity Layer (L₆):</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-809c-a795-d09ba6f3adbb" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Stable self-image and observable personality emerge from long-term repetition.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8069-b638-d683926d86cb" class="">Rule:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80a1-b704-d8d05bdc8b2a" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Stable identity shift = run this algorithm again with modified L₁–L₃.<br/>Changing L₄ alone (thoughts, 
narratives) is insufficient.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80f3-99e5-d42fb764176a"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-807e-aae9-c9ec20ede898" class="">B6. 
Identity Collapse Algorithm</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8093-aaba-cd8d03a2e228" class="">Identity collapse follows a specific cascade:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8047-ad5a-fb52dacacb80" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Layer 2 overload (chemistry):</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80cf-b449-e24beadd29c3" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Persistent stress state, dysregulated emotion.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8000-881d-d078f870aabb" class="numbered-list" start="2"><li><strong>Layer 3 overload (biology):</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80f9-a9dc-d2e3a52ba3f9" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Chronic tension, trauma activation, autonomic instability.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8061-aa62-fbcccfe328c2" class="numbered-list" start="3"><li><strong>Layer 4 distortion (cognition):</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-806a-bb98-d87bc0b2034e" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Irrational narratives, self-deception, incoherent beliefs.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8061-a6dd-ce55812eb828" class="numbered-list" start="4"><li><strong>Layer 5 inconsistency (behaviour):</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8053-9ae0-d91ceccacdef" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Unpredictable actions, broken commitments, 
moral drift.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-807e-8a2c-cf2e52cf97be" class="numbered-list" start="5"><li><strong>Layer 6 fragmentation (identity):</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-808c-a133-d55379993a35" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">“I don’t know who I am”, breakdown of stable self.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8065-b50f-c1f40ffc2b68" class="">Algorithmically:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-806e-872c-ead18813ef93" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Overload(L₂) → Destabilise(L₃) → Distort(L₄) → Incoherent(L₅) → Fragment(L₆)</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8004-af20-ddfa79ab7d55" class="">Recovery requires reversing up the chain, not starting from narrative.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8024-bf4b-d011c986c183"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-804c-9242-c24393917a6a" class="">B7. 
Identity Repair Algorithm</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8059-a0f4-cb0fea7288e1" class="">To repair identity at canon level:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8010-a8b1-e82202f346d8" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Stabilise chemistry (L₂):</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b0-92e1-d28583782c78" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Sleep, nutrition, movement, environmental load.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-806a-84d7-c1e3aeea3088" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Remove chronic chemical extremes.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8048-9924-c5c76219ffbe" class="numbered-list" start="2"><li><strong>Stabilise biology (L₃):</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8050-8353-c3305ff28311" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Nervous system regulation, somatic release, safety restoration.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80db-ad70-eae0b4186c21" class="numbered-list" start="3"><li><strong>Stabilise cognition (L₄):</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-801a-b42a-ff5799966d92" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Clean, accurate language.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-801f-a53f-ff1e65921992" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Remove distortions, 
tighten mapping between inner and outer.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8058-926c-fafc2c36603e" class="numbered-list" start="4"><li><strong>Stabilise behaviour (L₅):</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-802d-bca9-fd5f91e238ef" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Enforce small, consistent actions aligned with clarified cognition.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-809b-81af-c9e09038fe8c" class="numbered-list" start="5"><li><strong>Allow identity (L₆)</strong> to reconsolidate from new pattern.</li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80c3-8c13-ce08d29e3924"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8059-b4ee-d78699efab5d" class="">B8. 
Ethical Logic Algorithm (Applied Logic → Ethics)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80d6-9a65-f3d1d359adad" class="">You defined ethics as “applied logic of sustainability”.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80bd-93aa-d278b0da4860" class="">Algorithm:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80e8-8b51-c03e54e94398" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li>For any action A on system S:<div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80a6-9bb7-cf95f2694918" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Map affected layers: physical, biological, cognitive, 
social.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8038-bc55-ed9ea0c26afe" class="numbered-list" start="2"><li>Evaluate impact on Integrity:<div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8084-bdde-c0ade6a1c4f3" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Does A increase or decrease internal consistency of S?</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-809e-b7c4-c483be89e4ee" class="numbered-list" start="3"><li>Evaluate impact on Stability:<div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80e9-8c16-dd37768c077f" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Does A increase or decrease long-term resilience of S?</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8095-abb3-de26d389da70" class="numbered-list" start="4"><li>Decision rule:<div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-802c-9a60-cae18a462902" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">If A raises both Integrity and Stability → ethically correct.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80d7-8869-d08dfe95aaa6" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">If A lowers either in a critical way → ethically incorrect.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-809b-9d34-cba552c9449f" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">If tradeoff exists → optimise for long-term Integrity + Stability, not short-term gain.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80cc-aa93-f36c6c993c9b" class="">Ethics becomes:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8004-9bac-ffb843656c6c" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"><strong>Ethical(A, 
S)</strong> ⇔ ΔIntegrity(S) ≥ threshold ∧ ΔStability(S) ≥ threshold.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80f5-b76d-d28357ae778f"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80bf-8f1e-fb4a965c3751" class="">B9. 
Law of Law Enforcement Algorithm</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80f6-bb3f-dfb531462d40" class="">The Law of Law is your meta-law that governs all laws/frameworks:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8071-a2df-ce9cf3553bd6" class="">A candidate law L is valid only if:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8005-9a73-c84bb4cf173b" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Self-Consistency:</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8071-9e70-de50973a0f79" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">L does not contradict itself.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-804a-a95b-d85a2f9366dc" class="numbered-list" start="2"><li><strong>Cross-Consistency:</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80fe-b5d1-d6b7053f8296" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">L does not contradict higher-order meta-laws already accepted.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8028-a0ca-cbbc7e3ee306" class="numbered-list" start="3"><li><strong>Universal Applicability:</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80bb-a523-fb8fa1e34910" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">When applied to all relevant domains, 
L does not generate systemic contradiction.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b6-9329-f1daf9d15b89" class="numbered-list" start="4"><li><strong>Recursive Validity:</strong><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80da-ae70-d5cc9e310655" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">L remains valid when applied to itself.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-809e-82a9-edad09cf6986" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Its own use does not violate its requirements.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-806e-adca-d79953119257" class="">Algorithm:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8053-a22d-dfdc985122fa" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li>Test L for self-consistency.</li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-804d-a3f8-eafecdba9e47" class="numbered-list" start="2"><li>Test L against Law of Law, Rule of 2, Rule of 4.</li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-804e-b820-e517dbf84146" class="numbered-list" start="3"><li>Apply L across domains &amp; scales; check for persistent consistency.</li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-802d-8dd3-ec495737c2fb" class="numbered-list" start="4"><li>Apply L to itself; check for paradox.</li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-808b-ad99-c801afb1e0df" class="numbered-list" start="5"><li>Only then admit L as part of canon.</li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80c0-905a-fa131099f528"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-801b-b629-e8251e826ac8" class="">B10. 
Rule of 2 Algorithm (Duality Check)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80c1-8bfb-e42ecd3ba294" class="">For any proposition, system, or model X:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80f2-ac09-c0846e3a6e58" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li>Identify its dual counterpart Y (internal/external, self/other, micro/macro, etc.).</li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8077-bf91-fd0592ecc9fb" class="numbered-list" start="2"><li>Evaluate X in isolation.</li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80ab-9fdf-d40517bc123e" class="numbered-list" start="3"><li>Evaluate Y in isolation.</li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8063-9164-f416863baafc" class="numbered-list" start="4"><li>Evaluate X–Y interaction.</li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80a4-9580-db29052cdd08" class="numbered-list" start="5"><li>If X is valid but X–Y interaction breaks, X is incomplete.</li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80d6-b41f-fb6cd7f44da8" class="">Outcome:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8078-8859-f2bb5495edcb" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">No element is accepted without dual mapping and cross-consistency check.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-808d-84be-d751e90e7cff"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80bb-818a-e465db4bfb59" class="">B11. 
Rule of 4 Algorithm (Quadrant Mapping)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-809e-894e-f6aa82385f50" class="">For any complex phenomenon P:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80a2-86dc-dd95c3c73dad" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li>Map it across four canonical quadrants (e.g.):<div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-806c-99a0-f455f65473f6" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Internal–Individual</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8041-bab3-d7ae2d6d41d3" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">External–Individual</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-804a-bb78-f2f2013c8aa1" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Internal–Systemic</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b1-9293-dd7109b89d98" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">External–Systemic</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8034-a6eb-ef16889a91b5" class="numbered-list" start="2"><li>For each quadrant Qᵢ:<div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-806d-85b1-c78bb663eadc" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Define observable variables.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80fd-9082-c74ff3131939" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Define constraints and interactions.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80bf-bdeb-ed713f150d72" class="numbered-list" start="3"><li>Check cross-quadrant consistency:<div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8026-8f96-f06ab78d9fa2" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">No quadrant description may contradict a
nother.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-807b-b2f9-f844254aec1b" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">All must fit into a unified causal picture.</li></ul></div></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80ea-971c-fd8f5f582a20" class="">Rule:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8010-ab91-c22eeca911d5" class="">No model of P is considered complete until all four quadrants are mapped and cross-consistent.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80a8-8395-fc7e54566910"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8027-892d-f4a294f1f591" class="">C. 
Check for Gaps and Overlaps Inside This List</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-800e-be67-d696a1626641" class="">Within the scope of what we have explicitly articulated in this conversation:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8019-a5f9-eb7fa82baec9" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">All <strong>equations</strong> here are distinct:<div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80dc-b7db-e938fb3cb5b1" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:circle">Existence condition (Logic(S,T))</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8051-9a73-d88a429b337d" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:circle">Logic strength (L = f(I,S))</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80da-acec-cc5ae727faa8" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:circle">Emergence (E = i²)</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8080-8ce7-ca1fd7fc587c" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:circle">Consciousness function (C = g(R,P))</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80f4-8d58-ee84f05dbac2" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:circle">Correctness as persistence</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8022-a343-d3b9aca696bf" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:circle">Identity as multi-layer function</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80f6-8018-f67b34b7eed0" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:circle">Failure and recovery geometries</li></ul></div></li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80e3-a9d7-f3514267892c" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">All <strong>algorithms</strong> here are distinct but interlocking:<div s
tyle="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8002-8d02-d3ab1b4fa3fe" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:circle">QLS loop (Discriminate → Compress → Predict → Correct)</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-807b-82c7-e076de8f85ae" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:circle">Measuring logic</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8025-b544-efd0708d6f70" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:circle">Detecting failure</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8056-b30c-f36be1555a4e" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:circle">Recovering logic</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8026-94db-dad1820df885" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:circle">Forming identity</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-806e-9d52-e1092612914d" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:circle">Collapsing identity</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8020-87e6-fed742919202" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:circle">Repairing identity</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-800e-b7e8-d0084c1e7ed7" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:circle">Ethical decision logic</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80bb-baab-d8ad80ef69c2" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:circle">Law of Law enforcement</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-806d-a6af-c0cd6003211e" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:circle">Rule of 2 duality check</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8050-b8f0-f21adb5283b3" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:circle">Rule of 4 quadrant m

L(S,t) \;=\; I(S,t)\;\cdot\;\Sigma(S,t)
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-806a-9fee-cc34b0b5b12b"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b6-9a4a-eedde9052c74" class=""><strong>(F₅) Temporal derivative of logical strength</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80bd-9443-d84113a8753e" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">

Correctness, Truth, and Models</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8041-85f4-ce8f5c943a6a" class=""><strong>(F₆) Model correctness under feedback</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8014-8497-fb681cf32273" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">

d\big(P_M(e,t),\;O(e,t)\big) \;\leq\; \varepsilon
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-801c-8879-f491100c7d24" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">: relevant events</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8072-ad28-f41ee6087be7" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">: model prediction</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8017-b644-e4d60e70fd76" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">: observed outcome</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80f4-b986-de75027834b5" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">: distance metric</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-801e-8738-ff5f176c7e4e" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">: tolerance bound</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-807c-b067-d5926f0b5093"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-804f-b528-e714e1c4de2e" class=""><strong>(F₇) Truth as persistent correctness</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80c9-89d7-e24658d867c2" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\mathrm{Truth}(M) \;=\;
\lim_{T \to \infty} \Bigg[

\Bigg]

Emergence Law (Quantum Logic Rule)</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80d6-9c38-cdd766a2ca1f" class=""><strong>(F₈) Dual-layer information</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8042-bccc-fe28afe33874" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
