Ethics as Applied Logic</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-804a-a2f4-c86610c6f466" class=""><strong>(F₁₉) Logical effect of action</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-807b-8be5-c1a8680e61b1" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\Delta I(S,A) \;=\; I(S_{A},t_{+}) - I(S,t_{-})
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8085-8e26-c64e6579818e" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\Delta \Sigma(S,A) \;=\;
\Sigma(S_{A},t_{+}) - \Sigma(S,t_{-})
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8069-bcfe-d4d84a5a3ddf" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">: system after action</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-800a-971e-e2cba70c8195" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">: just before / after</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80bc-a1dc-fac2ef2336a8"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8007-88b2-ce427fe382d6" class=""><strong>(F₂₀) Ethical evaluation</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8050-9902-e5240d017722" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\mathrm{Eth}(A,S) \;=\;
\mathrm{sign}\Big(
w_I\,\Delta I(S,A)
\;+\;
w_\Sigma\,\Delta \Sigma(S,A)
\Big)
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-802d-972c-d3cdb6789836" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">: weights for integrity and stability</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8071-b77b-f6f1b462cdf0" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">: positive, neutral, or negative valuation</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8084-80de-c6ca947af50c"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80bf-a77f-f4bc33f1f5cb" class="">I. Planetary and Systemic Intelligence</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80f8-97a4-cf829fa40217" class=""><strong>(F₂₁) Planetary intelligence field</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8044-aa1e-c6df325bae3c" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\Pi(t) \;=\;
\Psi\big(
\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{phys}}(t),\;
\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{bio}}(t),\;
\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{soc}}(t),\;
\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{tech}}(t)
\big)
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b8-b59a-ed6e623205a0" class="">Each  is a multi-scale state tensor for that domain.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80ad-8e25-f0dea030b1e7"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80a1-bf85-e5261157c27a" class=""><strong>(F₂₂) Planetary alignment score</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b2-b53a-eb269b25dd79" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\mathcal{A}_{\Pi}(t) \;=\;
\mathrm{Align}\Big(
I_{\mathrm{local}}(t),\;
I_{\mathrm{global}}(t)
\Big)
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80ce-9906-f4a99d25d7ae" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">: mean integrity of local systems</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8063-85ed-f7361f20ec1f" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">: emergent integrity of planetary stack</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80de-aa12-c38ffe00e89c"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8061-8504-e3d683093f44" class="">J. Meta-Laws: Law of Law, Rule of Two, Rule of Four</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8096-a9c1-e6cb2b17b240" class=""><strong>(F₂₃) Law of Law</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80e2-a59e-fd21949e981a" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\mathrm{Valid}(\mathcal{L}_k) \;\Longleftrightarrow\;
\mathcal{S}(\mathcal{L}_k)
\;\land\;
\mathcal{C}_{\times}(\mathcal{L}_k)
\;\land\;
\mathcal{U}(\mathcal{L}_k)
\;\land\;
\mathcal{R}(\mathcal{L}_k)
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8020-8983-e3d2f5acc8a9" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">: self-consistency</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8093-a0a4-eac506935ec4" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">: cross-consistency with all other validated laws</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80a3-bc5a-fc8b1170bba5" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">: universality across domains</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b1-8b22-e96f1b2429dd" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">: recursive stability under its own application</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b5-ba44-cdf16c8e22c8"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8079-a526-fa9d0424f08b" class=""><strong>(F₂₄) Rule of Two (duality integrity)</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80ea-8b88-dac2da7070e5" class="">For any entity  with dual :</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b0-9131-d4fc4ecf8b0f" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\mathcal{D}(X) \;=\; Y
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-806b-ab2b-de5407386ef3" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\mathrm{Valid}_{\mathrm{dual}}(X) \;\Longleftrightarrow\;
\mathcal{S}(X)
\;\land\;
\mathcal{S}(Y)
\;\land\;
\mathcal{S}(X \leftrightarrow Y)
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80c3-8957-d54a13d99e9d" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">: duality operator</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8014-aafd-daedf7c3988b"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8076-b240-c516d26f6f91" class=""><strong>(F₂₅) Rule of Four (quadrant integrity)</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8022-9c99-ecbda7b9a1ed" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
Q \;=\;
\{q_{\mathrm{inner}},\;
q_{\mathrm{outer}},\;
q_{\mathrm{individual}},\;
q_{\mathrm{collective}}\}
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8003-a33e-f773fcacf191" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\mathrm{Valid}_{\mathrm{quad}}(Q) \;\Longleftrightarrow\;
\bigwedge_{q_i \in Q}\mathcal{S}(q_i)
\;\land\;
\bigwedge_{(q_i,q_j)}\mathcal{S}(q_i \leftrightarrow q_j)
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-806e-b255-d2fef69c8334" class="">(Each quadrant self-consistent and mutually consistent.)</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8043-bd54-f5614e6cfd54"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-807e-b946-cdbc44426f63" class="">K. Logic Metric for Any System</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80da-89af-d4a83af01052" class=""><strong>(F₂₆) Unified logic metric</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80a8-a33a-df11e7ba52b7" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\Lambda(S,t) \;=\;
\Big[
I(S,t),\;
\Sigma(S,t),\;
L(S,t),\;
\mathcal{I}(S,t),\;
\mathcal{C}(t)
\Big]
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80bd-bfb1-ed94c0ab1d6e" class="">Vector metric capturing structural logic state at time .</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-806d-998d-c432ae100d56"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b5-80e5-f76d19b9c19a" class="">If you want, the next step can be:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8030-9195-e6c3331f71af" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">mapping each framework (QLS, UBI, PSI, QCLA, ULP, ULF, TSS, etc.) explicitly onto this equation set, or</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8072-b2e6-f8ea4bc95e99" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">expanding any single formula (for example for consciousness, or as a family of operators) into full technical specification.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-804d-aaf1-dd4f11e74e6b" class="">I will treat this as <strong>Volume II — The Laws of Existence</strong>, and give you the <strong>full canonical law set + formal equations</strong>, 
in a way that is:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8086-ad6f-dd885c4aa0bc" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">MECE (no overlap)</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80be-9a0f-dfb8bce75702" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Gapless (no missing slots)</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-800f-bbe5-c3a779644ba3" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Consistent with your canon: no “coherence” / “field” etc.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80ad-914e-d4259633a588" class="">I will be concise but structurally complete.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-803b-a2d3-c3eba0de3e83"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80c4-8cb9-ead12b42a923" class="">META-LAYER</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8082-87aa-eb3c61424fc9" class="">LAW 1 — LAW OF LAW</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80dc-8da4-d97b7512bee6" class=""><strong>Type:</strong> Meta-law over all other laws.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80e8-b85c-eda02d0c5c5c" class=""><strong>Canonical statement</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8057-a478-d645f58c1780" class="">A law is valid only if it is internally consistent, cross-domain stable, 
and non-redundant under composition with all other laws.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8045-9d71-d9bbde4a40a0" class=""><strong>Core objects</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80f1-a3e2-eababad807a7" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Set of candidate laws:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80d5-8f74-cdadb798a438" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Integrity of a law:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80d0-9ca3-ff1d25710da1" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Stability of a law under application:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-806d-8686-d1090c2e6920" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Redundancy of a law relative to others:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80cc-b954-d43826b81154" class=""><strong>Validity equation</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80fc-a87b-e0d9d72d5fc5" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
V_L(L_i) = I_L(L_i) \cdot S_L(L_i) \cdot (1 - R_L(L_i | \mathcal{L}\setminus\{L_i\}))
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80a9-82ed-c9d3fa0e58c8" class=""><strong>Law-of-Law condition</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8069-a97a-ed969a322f94" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
L_i \text{ is canonical} \;\Longleftrightarrow\; V_L(L_i) = 1
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80d8-8506-d7d1bbfd25aa" class="">(“1” here is the <strong>integrity ceiling</strong>, not a numeric probability.)</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80e8-ac52-e70d4d97d8c3"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80e0-b2ca-f44c75a478cd" class="">LAW 2 — RULE OF TWO (DUALITY LAW)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80dd-9732-f314eb295ca8" class=""><strong>Type:</strong> Structural meta-law.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8010-b563-c116dbd6121d" class=""><strong>Canonical statement</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8054-b67c-d6594cc55d97" class="">Every complete system description requires at least one structurally paired dual: two complementary aspects whose interaction generates the system’s behaviour.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80f5-85f3-d618fbd3bdc3" class=""><strong>Core objects</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8058-b934-ce85ef2879ef" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">System:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8045-81f4-e0feda2c6422" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Dual pair:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80de-83d7-cc17559d2d4f" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Dual mapping:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8005-83d5-c38547def60d" class=""><strong>Dual completeness</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8071-9516-c0e4229998d5" class="">For any system , 
there exists  such that:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80af-89db-fb23744f1394" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
X = f(x^{+}, x^{-})
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8045-b088-d899563485c4" class="">with</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b9-8391-c4ec9dda8e8e" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\frac{\partial f}{\partial x^{+}} \neq 0,\quad \frac{\partial f}{\partial x^{-}} \neq 0
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8074-9b30-c21c4eaa5ff9" class="">(i.e. 
both poles are causally relevant).</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-802b-bb12-fb1da0b1ea22"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80ae-899e-cffa869fb9bb" class="">LAW 3 — RULE OF FOUR (QUADRANT LAW)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-802b-9da5-d066e44289c7" class=""><strong>Type:</strong> Structural meta-law.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-801e-ba48-dbf4c7c5676a" class=""><strong>Canonical statement</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8060-bfc7-c6b34d10e278" class="">Any fully specified system requires four entangled aspects (a quadrant) to resolve all dual interactions without hidden contradictions.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8046-8252-e7e75ae8b2cb" class=""><strong>Core objects</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80a3-b281-d3ccd5e6a324" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Quadrant:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8017-a9d2-f15d56481e16" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Coverage function: — proportion of system behaviour explained.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8091-969d-eb96fe68a757" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Residual unexplained behaviour:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-802d-9356-f20c78bca9a1" class=""><strong>Quadrant completeness</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" h
ref="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8064-9964-daf1b4fbe702" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
Q \text{ is complete} \;\Longleftrightarrow\; U(Q) = 0
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80a7-827f-d8681657cf37" class="">with the independence condition:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-800d-ae19-f59f03d51753" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\forall i \neq j:\; \text{Overlap}(q_i, q_j) &lt; 1
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8039-9aa9-c2dede438949" class="">(i.e. no quadrant is a re-labeling of another.)</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8026-b7b1-cb37196d0f5b"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8028-b66f-eba6e6dee5a7" class="">LAW 4 — LAW OF EMERGENCE (E = i²)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-803d-b29a-ef65740c48bc" class=""><strong>Type:</strong> Meta-law of emergent behaviour.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-805a-89a6-cf5b6f78553d" class=""><strong>Canonical statement</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80bd-8457-dceb1a4fa33c" class="">Emergent behaviour arises from the structured interaction of two information layers. 
The “square” is a <strong>dual-layer operator</strong>, not arithmetic exponentiation.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-809d-ade5-c2cb7f98ba9f" class=""><strong>Core objects</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8024-a6f0-fea4ee5b0cfd" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Internal information state:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80d8-ac79-c2e97211f0ba" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">External / contextual information state:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8079-ac4e-e5eb16b011cd" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Emergent expression:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-804d-8557-ea462df797ef" class=""><strong>Operator form</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8033-8b88-ed40ed4972a5" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
E = \mathcal{I}^2(i_{\text{int}}, i_{\text{ext}}) := \Phi(i_{\text{int}}, i_{\text{ext}})
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8014-8d46-da65b524196e" class="">with:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80ed-b3c8-c8874b93ed14" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"></li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8058-86ce-da0428244dde" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc"></li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-802b-b1d1-f91cd31d337f" class="">and <strong>no emergent expression</strong> when either layer is absent:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80c9-9dba-f69ea62229bc" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\|i_{\text{int}}\| = 0 \;\text{or}\; \|i_{\text{ext}}\| = 0 \;\Longrightarrow\; E = 0
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80f6-93af-dd4ec49d43b6" class="">(That last “0” is the <strong>null state</strong> outside existence; you can treat it as the mathematical boundary, not a biological state.)</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80e3-b80d-c726e85bd27c"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-806d-b453-d415aa81caa9" class="">EXISTENCE &amp; LOGIC LAYER</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8040-85ea-d146597cfb5a" class="">LAW 5 — LAW OF INTEGRITY</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8054-8834-ca3921a64298" class=""><strong>Type:</strong> Structural law.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-803f-8560-ea6ae3d17a4b" class=""><strong>Canonical statement</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8080-8a9f-c88482ee7e1e" class="">Every real system has a definable degree of internal non-contradiction. 
This integrity governs how much information it can carry without self-cancelling.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80d9-9bfd-e48f56a36b9e" class=""><strong>Core objects</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8005-bd00-d868feaf19b1" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">System:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80fb-ab2f-f5c7cb290ad8" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Set of internal relations:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80d3-a472-c9f90c77e71b" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Contradiction functional:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80ca-ab7c-d26f472d6aa9" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Integrity:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8058-be3a-d6efb63052d5" class=""><strong>Integrity measure</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8006-97d6-ff69b76c6105" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
I(X) = 1 - \frac{\mathcal{C}(X)}{C_{\max}}
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8007-bdd0-fa0689c28fc2" class="">Interpretation:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-807c-8f9c-e624a9b19773" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">counts logical conflicts / incompatible constraints.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8042-84db-f66c266e1a88" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">is the maximum conflict capacity for that class of system.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-806e-9c64-e0c1d97f1aa1"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8079-b429-f1327da14fb8" class="">LAW 6 — LAW OF STABILITY</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b4-9f94-c2ce68c3f31c" class=""><strong>Type:</strong> Temporal law.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-804b-bf8f-dbd95add2991" class=""><strong>Canonical statement</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-800c-840c-d9774f2ad0e2" class="">A system’s endurance under change is governed by its capacity to absorb perturbations while maintaining functional output.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-802e-a8e7-f1c05d48ab30" class=""><strong>Core objects</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8087-9e35-ea3ea161d0a3" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">System state:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-803f-838f-fb24d4147703" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Perturbation:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8009-b614-c1243d25e37e" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Output / performance:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul i
d="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80be-b2dd-cd4c36dab5fd" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Stability:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80d0-8253-d7b3ca70cc0d" class=""><strong>Stability measure</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-803a-9684-ee8ed72fd030" class="">Let  be the reference output trajectory. Define deviation:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8008-b618-ecdad07d0999" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
d(t) = \|O(t) - O_{\text{ref}}(t)\|
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80f2-80b8-d90c04c87ec3" class="">Then over an observation window :</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8092-8663-c149100bf674" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
S(X) = 1 - \frac{1}{K}\int_{t_1}^{t_2} d(t)\,dt
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8084-97ca-d513359f6456" class="">with  chosen so that .</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8024-bae4-d4d912735985"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80c5-8c46-da49bd638f39" class="">LAW 7 — LAW OF PERSISTENCE (LOGIC = INTEGRITY × STABILITY)</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8026-ac1d-f73f09115df2" class=""><strong>Type:</strong> Logic law.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80a8-ad9d-c8ac6ab98cd3" class=""><strong>Canonical statement</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80cc-9b92-ca996bfedd99" class="">Logical strength of any system is the joint product of its internal integrity and its temporal stability.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80bf-9156-d7ffb84889cb" class=""><strong>Core objects</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80f9-9604-c893f85d5681" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Integrity:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80f5-855a-d0e89ac875f0" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Stability:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80c2-906e-ea4d622ea525" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Logical strength:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80a9-8992-e4faa79a103f" class=""><strong>Logic equation</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" h
ref="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8046-a6ae-c67df84e35bc" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
L(X) = I(X) \cdot S(X)
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-804e-9a8d-ec2389d2a6fc" class="">Interpretation:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-806e-821b-d6aa01e0365e" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">High , low → rigid but fragile.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8050-bd03-d0b2c2f9e626" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Low , high → dull but persistent.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-801f-8f15-f42900f5d5f2" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">High , high → truly logical system.</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8072-ab6a-c136cfe08f38"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80d5-9b08-eca6eac5e575" class="">LAW 8 — LAW OF COLLAPSE</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8058-a5bb-e4880b7b8bd0" class=""><strong>Type:</strong> Failure law.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80ad-8a91-cb6044db8cef" class=""><strong>Canonical statement</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-807d-b865-e92eafce9755" class="">Collapse is the terminal stage of a four-step process: contradiction, distortion, drift, and disintegration. 
Once an upper threshold is crossed, 
recovery is no longer possible without structural re-design.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8041-a93b-cbaf2b7fb9a8" class=""><strong>Core objects</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80e3-840b-db07c114aa2c" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Contradiction level:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8095-b5b4-e3775455772a" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Distortion level:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8079-9f36-fd4ced792e8e" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Drift magnitude:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80f4-9948-c7fd4fdab13c" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">System integrity:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8079-9cdf-d96a610f56af" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Collapse threshold:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-809c-9f2b-d291dd1b3d4a" class=""><strong>Dynamics (schematic)</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80e2-a163-cf856048436c" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Contradiction growth</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre i
d="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8002-8b80-c4adf5bf77f6" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\frac{dk}{dt} &gt; 0 \quad \text{when feedback is suppressed}
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8095-af53-e346a323e160" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Distortion</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80f7-8e94-c3d57e645efe" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
d(t) = g_1(k(t)), \quad g_1&#x27; &gt; 0
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8099-a91d-ee574115405c" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Drift</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8069-be6a-da633f4ef0f5" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\Delta(t) = g_2(d(t)), \quad g_2&#x27; &gt; 0
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ol type="1" id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80c8-9d19-ca05edb09596" class="numbered-list" start="1"><li><strong>Disintegration</strong></li></ol></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80cf-abdb-f6773f9fe1eb" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
I(t) = 1 - h(\Delta(t)), \quad h&#x27; &gt; 0
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-801c-a80b-fcad9281b5be" class=""><strong>Collapse condition</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-803f-8a46-f44e629d8798" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
I(t) \leq \theta_{\text{col}} \;\Longrightarrow\; \text{system enters non-recoverable collapse without redesign}
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-805f-9556-e4bb35557c21"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h2 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80dc-b415-fe523aeb9ce5" class="">INFORMATION &amp; INTELLIGENCE LAYER</h2></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-802c-9d19-f7a3d1b76ddb" class="">LAW 9 — LAW OF INFORMATION INTERACTION</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8089-9385-e2f500eaf0b2" class=""><strong>Type:</strong> Information law.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80d1-8b6b-f79c16a8061f" class=""><strong>Canonical statement</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8039-9a3f-d75163dade59" class="">All meaningful change arises from interaction between at least two information states. 
Isolated information cannot produce emergence.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-808e-af6b-c61cff65b568" class=""><strong>Core objects</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8025-86e8-e5b00716751d" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Internal information state:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80ab-aa1e-c5f15adebf0a" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">External information state:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8086-b8d3-f5603171c61d" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Interaction operator:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8087-acab-ccbe51d6a9de" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Effective information flow:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b6-b022-eac56c17ea95" class=""><strong>Interaction equation</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80eb-948f-c31395bacab6" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
J = i_{\text{int}} \otimes i_{\text{ext}}
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8007-8a82-ee4af773529f" class="">with the non-triviality condition:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-808e-9e4c-d2470b83e360" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
\|J\| &gt; 0 \;\Longleftrightarrow\; \|i_{\text{int}}\| &gt; 0 \;\land\; \|i_{\text{ext}}\| &gt; 0
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-800b-9308-deb43e5479fa" class="">Combined with Law 4 (Emergence):</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80ea-9e9d-f288c41ee1a0" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
E = \Phi(J)
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8086-b845-f85f7886d7c8"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-802c-9d77-daf638bc7657" class="">LAW 10 — LAW OF IDENTITY ALIGNMENT</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80de-bb74-e21c262cc137" class=""><strong>Type:</strong> Identity / self-governance law.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8087-bf13-f99953342a2b" class=""><strong>Canonical statement</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80cf-a2b0-d15bc32ed381" class="">Identity integrity is determined by the alignment between emotion, cognition, 
and action over time.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-804c-9570-f4ff2a3823d1" class=""><strong>Core objects</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8074-8053-c4363605e538" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Emotional state vector:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8089-9a17-d1ae8b976d7f" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Cognitive state vector:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-801b-910a-dc8340dc5adc" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Action vector:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80fa-80d9-f8dd332fddd9" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Alignment functional:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8052-9301-f701c0961460" class=""><strong>Alignment equation</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80c1-b7da-e2965c5eac88" class="">Define pairwise agreement:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-801f-a1e3-e61b3fea6474" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
A_{ec} = \cos\angle(e, c), \quad
A_{ca} = \cos\angle(c, a), \quad
A_{ea} = \cos\angle(e, a)
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80ba-bcc0-de7f6eef8c54" class="">Then:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80ba-8930-fb21222b8988" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
A = \left(\frac{A_{ec} + A_{ca} + A_{ea}}{3}\right)^{\gamma}
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b7-bf29-ed59374aacad" class="">with  to penalise misalignment.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-804e-a9f8-ecb58decbd90"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80f4-8504-d1ea68d7696b" class="">LAW 11 — LAW OF INTELLIGENCE</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80f0-bac0-f3e6abc435e7" class=""><strong>Type:</strong> Intelligence law.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80d7-b6fa-de98d9a40ef7" class=""><strong>Canonical statement</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80f6-b297-c36ab44a58e9" class="">Intelligence is the system’s capacity to maintain alignment between its internal model and external reality under continuous feedback and change.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-805f-8bcd-e746692394b1" class=""><strong>Core objects</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8099-ab7b-d79d56d22179" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Model state:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8095-920d-df1d4488e7db" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Environment / reality state:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80f5-a7e4-ff0d3b2a326c" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Prediction operator:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-805e-9f91-c9d9c3d3bfe6" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Error:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-807f-aebf-eaba33995264" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Feedback bandwidth / responsiveness:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul i
d="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80c2-85a2-f4a089e931c5" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Intelligence measure:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-809a-ab52-c1ceed409fc2" class=""><strong>Intelligence equation</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80cf-8a50-f37a2d1c5caa" class="">Over window :</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b6-8c7d-c191546929c8" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
E_{\text{avg}} = \frac{1}{t_2 - t_1} \int_{t_1}^{t_2} \|e(t)\|\, dt
</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80f0-ab05-da63b15dfd99" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">

</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-800a-9058-ca5f1179cca2" class="">with  scaling error impact.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-806d-8950-dba08419ea0d" class="">Interpretation:</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80ab-ab4c-ef4295453b32" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">High feedback + low sustained error → high .</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80d8-8921-d39c9c8b3e72" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Suppressed feedback or uncorrected error → low .</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><hr id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8017-b791-c8da9894c99f"/></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><h3 id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8019-9da1-cbee275257ea" class="">LAW 12 — LAW OF CONSCIOUS INTEGRATION</h3></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-808b-9b33-d9a98f94a506" class=""><strong>Type:</strong> Awareness law.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80d0-bc57-db33f1910d71" class=""><strong>Canonical statement</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80ef-b996-ede6166a78f0" class="">Conscious awareness arises when biochemical integrity and neural synchrony reach a shared threshold of integrated activity.</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8003-a9d6-d8f57d0fc4d2" class=""><strong>Core objects</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80d0-bbef-ef1219a48738" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Biochemical integrity index:</li></ul></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><ul id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8048-a8e6-d3b409461b96" class="bulleted-list"><li style="list-style-type:disc">Neural synchrony index (phase locking,

</code></pre></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80c4-8d80-e4a868412b0d" class="">with .</p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><p id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-80b9-8928-d3a3494bed84" class=""><strong>Activation condition</strong></p></div><div style="display:contents" dir="auto"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js" integrity="sha512-7Z9J3l1+EYfeaPKcGXu3MS/7T+w19WtKQY/n+xzmw4hZhJ9tyYmcUS+4QqAlzhicE5LAfMQSF3iFTK9bQdTxXg==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism.min.css" integrity="sha512-tN7Ec6zAFaVSG3TpNAKtk4DOHNpSwKHxxrsiw4GHKESGPs5njn/0sMCUMl2svV4wo4BK/rCP7juYz+zx+l6oeQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><pre id="2b3c5e6f-95bd-8066-b051-dee85a993a22" class="code code-wrap"><code class="language-LaTeX" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">
